title: feat(messaging): store a push device's origin at registration and carry it in every push to the device
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DUpvxmC7UGJmuMQW4ZsJoLR)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czbHcjvoBYWDw2gRAq

Fixes #29768

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手机注册推送设备时带上的 `origin`（控制台加载自哪台服务器）现在会存到 `sys_user_device` 上，`listDevices` 读得回来，每条推送的 `data` 里都带着它。
- 为什么改：裁决 B（#29642）的服务端一半。保存了两台服务器的手机壳，点开 B 服务器发来的推送会落到 A 上；有了 `origin`，壳就能按它打开正确的服务器。
- 风险与回滚：新增一个可空列，不带 `origin` 的注册与推送完全照旧；spec 只改描述和注释，不改校验。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/device-registry.ts` 的写行和 `toUserDevice`；推送通道的复制在 main 上已存在（`push-channel.ts` 的 `withOrigin`），本 PR 未改它。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/device-registry.integration.test.ts`，预期 14 passed。
- 需要你做的：无；席位验收、CI 全绿后落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/service-messaging`.**
- `sys_user_device` gains an optional `origin` text column, deliberately without `maxLength`: spec's origin pattern bounds the shape, not the length, so a bounded column could refuse a value the registration accepts.
- `DeviceRegistry` writes `origin: request.origin ?? null` beside `app_id` / `locale` on both the insert and the refresh (a refresh replaces it, as it does those two), and `toUserDevice` sets `device.origin` when the row holds one.
- The push channel already copied `device.origin` into each device's push `data` (`withOrigin` in `push-channel.ts`, landed with the channel); until now the registry never stored one, so nothing reached it. No change there.
- The field's label and help are translated in all ten shipped translated locales, ru, de and ko included since main added them (`check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, then hand translation, then `--write` again; the en bundle is regenerated from the source).

**`@objectstack/spec`, description and docblock only.**
- `RegisterDeviceRequestSchema.origin` and `UserDeviceSchema.origin` drop their `[PLANNED — not yet stored]` prefix; the marker pin in `push-server-origin.test.ts` is flipped to assert that no origin member is marked PLANNED.
- `push-server-origin.ts` docblock takes the three should-fix items of contract review 6595162668 by the docblock route: it names the DNS-label limit (`_` and a trailing-dot host are refused although `window.location.origin` can answer them), the port and IPv6 laxness with the Console as the one producer, and that a dotted IPv4 host is accepted. ⛔ The validator is unchanged.
- The `RegisterDeviceRequestSchema` docblock's refresh list now names every request member a refresh rewrites: token, vendor, platform, app, locale, origin and name.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`, `content/docs/references/system/push-device.mdx` (`gen:schema && gen:docs`).

**`@objectstack/service-push`, docblock only.** The `PushMessage` docblock in `push-service.ts` names `origin` as the third delivery-data member, present when the device registered one; the changeset carries `'@objectstack/service-push': patch` for it.

**Not changed, verified:** `packages/runtime/src/domains/notifications.ts` already hands `RegisterDeviceRequestSchema.safeParse(body).data` to `registerDevice`, so `origin` reaches the registry. Both transports in `service-push` spread `message.data` unchanged (FCM into `message.data`, APNs at the payload top level).

## Why

Ruling B on #29642 (record 6593872191, maintainer 「同意」): "the Console sends the origin it was loaded from in `RegisterDeviceRequest`. The server stores it on the `UserDevice` row, and the push channel copies it into `PushDeliveryDataSchema`." The spec half (PR #29767) is merged; this is the server half. The Console producer stays with #29042.

## Verification

Measured on `origin/main` `b77c160a` (registry and object reverted to main, the new pins kept): a registration with `origin: 'https://crm.example.com'` stored a row whose `origin` is `undefined`, `listDevices` answered no `origin`, and a push through the real channel over the real registry carried `{ notificationId, route }` only.

- `src/device-registry.integration.test.ts`, new top-level describe (4, real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver`): the registration's origin is stored and `listDevices` answers it; a registration without one stores `null` and the device has no `origin` member; a refresh replaces the stored origin and a refresh without one clears it; a push through `createPushChannel` with the `MessagingService` as its device registry carries the stored origin for that device and none for a device without one, and every data object parses as `PushDeliveryDataSchema`.
- `src/objects/user-device.object.test.ts` (+1): the `origin` column is optional text with no `maxLength`.
- `packages/spec/src/system/push-server-origin.test.ts`: the marker pin flipped.
- Ablations: registry and object at main ⇒ 4 red (the null/absent case is the negative control and stays green); only the read-back line removed ⇒ 2 red (list and push), the row pin green; the PLANNED prefix put back on `UserDeviceSchema.origin` ⇒ the flipped pin red. All green at head.
- `@objectstack/service-messaging`: 66 files / 850 tests green at `48036dd1`, 67 files / 858 tests green on the merged tree at `6dc84f5e`; `typecheck` green. `check-i18n-bundles.mjs`: in sync; `check:i18n-coverage`: none new. `@objectstack/spec` `check:generated`: every artifact current (`check:test-typecheck` needs an 8 GB heap in this container; green with it).
- Every `dispatch-gates --commands` family at `48036dd1`: 108 derived, 108 run, all exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED (`--ran` reconcile). `pnpm lint`: exit 0. The same sweep on the final head `6dc84f5e` is reported on the card.

Skills-docs: `git grep -n -i -E "registerDevice|notifications/devices|RegisterDeviceRequest|PushDeliveryData|push.*origin" -- skills content/docs` read: no `skills/**` hit; `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/push-service.mdx` already lists `origin` among the registration members and says nothing about it being unstored, still true; release notes untouched. Generated `content/docs/references/**` regenerated, not hand-edited.

Contract review 6672159811 (PASS on `48036dd1`) left two should-fix docblock items, the `PushMessage` data list and the refresh list; both are folded in at `7e4b969d`, delta review 6672299353 PASS. `ccea409a` merges `main`, whose new ru, de and ko service-messaging bundles lacked the new key (CI `check:i18n` / `check:i18n-coverage` on the merge ref), and `6dc84f5e` translates it in those three.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the lane's maintainer summary).
